description: This file defines the YarnRMClient class responsible for managing registration, unregistration, and configuration interactions with the YARN ResourceManager within the Spark deployment on YARN.

classes.name: YarnRMClient
classes.description: Manages registration and communication with the YARN ResourceManager for Spark on YARN.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the application master with the YARN ResourceManager.

methods.name: createAllocator
methods.description: Creates a YarnAllocator instance after registration.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the application master from YARN, ensuring it is only called once.

methods.name: getAmIpFilterParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the AmIpFilter for Spark UI.

methods.name: getMaxRegAttempts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of registration attempts for the application master.

methods.name: getUrlByRmId
methods.description: Constructs the URL for a given ResourceManager ID.
